title: Spicy Thai Bars
description: A unique Thai dessert using spicy and Syrian flavors. Perfect for those who like a little heat in their sweet treats.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt the spicy chocolate bars in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Stir in the Syrian cacao nibs until well combined.
Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly gooey.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely on the baking sheet.
Once cooled, break the bars into pieces and serve.
